name: Menlo Park
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Menlo Park, CA 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Menlo Park, CA: the Fremont Park tree lighting, Santa photos, a Grinch movie night, cocoa in Belle Haven and snow at Springline.
lede: Menlo Park celebrates Christmas with a run of small city events, from the oak tree lighting in Fremont Park downtown to cocoa and a Grinch movie night at the Belle Haven Community Campus.
celebrates: The City of Menlo Park opens the season with Light Up the Season, a tree lighting traditionally held on the first Friday in December in Fremont Park at Santa Cruz Avenue and University Drive. The city now lights a Menlo Park oak tree there, giving its old pine a rest. In the Belle Haven neighborhood, the city hosts Cocoa at the Campus with its own small tree lighting and a pajama movie night. Santa takes reserved visits at the Arrillaga Family Recreation Center, Springline on El Camino Real throws a holiday celebration with a snow playground, and the Allied Arts Guild holds a Christmas market.
lastyear: On Friday, December 5, 2025, Menlo Park held Light Up the Season from 5:30 to 7 pm in Fremont Park. InMenlo described a winter wonderland themed evening with free family entertainment, youth performances, hot cocoa in limited quantities and the tree lighting. A Menlo Park oak tree took the spotlight, because the beloved pine tree had been retired the year before, and local shops along Santa Cruz Avenue stayed open for the evening.
facts: Menlo Park's train station is the oldest continually operating railway station in California. It was one of the first stops on the San Francisco and San Jose Railroad when service began in 1863, and its station building dates from 1867. The city's holiday tree also changed recently: after years of lighting a pine in Fremont Park, the city switched to a Menlo Park oak. In 2026 the city is using its winter wonderland tree lighting to kick off its Centennial Celebration.
trains: Caltrain stops at Menlo Park station, whose 1867 building makes it the oldest continually operating station in California. The station sits steps from Santa Cruz Avenue and Fremont Park, and Springline on El Camino Real is right across the street. Just east of town, the Dumbarton Rail Bridge opened in 1910 as the first structure to span San Francisco Bay, though its last freight train ran in 1982. Caltrain to San Francisco reaches the Cable Car Museum and the San Francisco Railway Museum.

kidfact: Menlo Park's train station building is from 1867, and trains have stopped there every year since, making it the oldest working train station in California.
faq: Where is the Menlo Park tree lighting?

The City of Menlo Park lights its holiday tree in Fremont Park, at Santa Cruz Avenue and University Drive, during Light Up the Season. The city says the event is traditionally held on the first Friday in December, rain or shine, with youth performances and hot cocoa while it lasts, and downtown shops nearby.
Why does Menlo Park light an oak tree?

For years the city lit a pine tree in Fremont Park. That pine was retired, and the city now lights a Menlo Park oak in the park instead. The city describes it as giving the beloved pine tree a well deserved break, and the oak has been the star of the lighting since 2025.
Is there a Christmas event in Belle Haven?

Yes. The city holds Cocoa at the Campus at the Belle Haven Community Campus on Terminal Avenue, with a small tree lighting, youth performances, hot cocoa and mini churros. The same campus hosts the Popcorn and Pajamas Grinch movie night in December, so Belle Haven families have two city events close to home.
Can we take Caltrain to Menlo Park's holiday events?

Yes. Menlo Park station is a short walk from Fremont Park, Santa Cruz Avenue and the Arrillaga Family Recreation Center on Alma Street, and Springline sits across El Camino Real from the platform. The station building from 1867 is worth a look while you wait for your train.
